answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like an atlas that records each identity past work along a single river of attestations. A newcomer starts with no reputation and must complete low-paid, verifiable tasks over time, so creating a tide of fake identities means locking fresh stake for each one and waiting through the same slow history. An attacker can copy a profile, but cannot copy the costly, time-stamped record, so Sybil copies stay untrusted and unprofitable.
